scope: Offline implementation of mission-selected SITL vehicle; no Docker, simulation, flight, LLM provider or operational MCP

tests.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_simulated_vehicle_selection.py tests/test_simulation_mission_executor.py tests/test_virtual_preflight.py tests/test_virtual_preflight_jobs.py tests/test_vehicle_execution_lock.py tests/test_ros2_flight_control.py tests/test_mission_execution_gate.py tests/test_hermes_mcp_server.py

test_evidence_limits: Controls/readiness/Popen are doubles. Actual Python graph/executor/SDK dispatch/OS file locks exercised; not proof of operational v2 flight or LLM fidelity.
untracked_diff_check: all five new files clean; metadata rechecked after write
schema_hash_method: SDK list_tools name/input_schema sorted keys compact UTF-8 JSON; ordered tool list
mcp_contract: Tool names/arguments preserved; vehicle binding derived from mission. In-process registered tests only; no live stdio connection.
intentional_compatibility_limits: Legacy simultaneous shell demo disabled by wrapper/child verification before subprocess.
ROS flight primitives require a matching live project execution authority.
Old report bytes/hashes and v1 analysis semantics are retained; missing logical identities stay unknown.
pending: Authorized operational rehearsal of drone_02/v2 with actual AP_DDS/Gazebo remains untested.
No simultaneous flights, vehicle separation, agriculture, speed tracking, hardware, .plan loading, WP3 cause resolution or host-restart resilience demonstrated.
Cooperative project exclusion does not control external/manual ROS/QGC or guarantee mixed-version hot deployment.
Hash association does not solve all TOCTOU; acceptance never grants consent to another flight.
